answer: One defense is a vault-and-prism check guarding a shared haven: every identity locks its proof of work in a personal vault that opens only after a slow, sequential delay no one can parallelize, then a public prism splits that record into facets — time, cost, skill, provenance — each audited separately. Only an identity whose facets all check out may enter the haven. An honest agent opens one vault once; a sybil farmer must open a new vault and pass a full prism check for every fake, paying the delay and the work each time, and one cracked facet locks that fake out for good.
